status: Review-only host proposal and experimental task consumer; not enabled

environment.environment_origin: Existing caller-supplied PM test environment; no packages installed or modified

limits: Only trusted in-process text planning; not a Python/OS sandbox or tool-using worker
No production import, upstream adoption, installed-host modification or live model acceptance
Dedicated no-redirect/no-env HTTP client is implemented only in the isolated host proposal
SDK provider adapters, dynamic auth and query overrides are unsupported; parent transport/auth/hooks are not inherited
Same-process plugins and host code remain trusted, not an adversarial sandbox
Timeout/cancel discards late results but cannot guarantee request termination or undo billing
Provider model mismatch is detected after the response, not a guarantee of the actual served model
Durable local claims prevent automatic resubmission; unobserved results remain unknown and pending authorization is not adopted
Local receipts are not a provider transaction or exactly-once remote execution proof; no provider reconciliation or budget accounting
Ledger retains up to 64 records indefinitely, refuses at capacity, and has no cleanup/eviction operation
Observed config revocation is terminal; unobserved config ABA is not revision-fenced
Task revision checks, claim ledger and provider submission are separate operations; admitted snapshot may become stale
No task state mutation, full orchestration, Gateway end-to-end or automatic memory acceptance
Exact route fingerprints gate fresh live/cached draft returns; previously returned parent history is not retracted or isolated from later model switches
Native workbench reads persisted receipts via explicit scoped LOCAL commands; it neither polls a live worker nor cancels admitted work
Native exec output uses audited client display paths, not model submission; clients may cache it and live UI acceptance remains untested
